name: Merindad de Sotoscueva (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally red over yellow with a black triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of the Merindad de Sotoscueva (a castle on red, inscribed).
history: Municipal flag of Merindad de Sotoscueva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
